compiled_state.description:
S2 completion-verifier FAIL on DD5. Fix 4 legacy tests in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py that call append_cycle() without pr_number (ValueError after T2 sentinel guard) + 1 test asserting old schema_version='1.1.0' + perf benchmark crash with same root cause.

## Files to modify
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py — 4 tests
- tests/perf/test-cycle-ledger-perf.py — _measure_append_cycle()

2. test_append_cycle_increments_cycles_array: add pr_number=42 (or any non-sentinel int) to append_cycle call
3. test_concurrent_shell_and_python_writers_coordinate_on_lockfile: same — add pr_number
4. test_append_atomic_write_no_corruption_on_concurrent_appends: same — add pr_number
5. perf benchmark _measure_append_cycle: pass non-zero pr_number to append_cycle calls

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 4 cycle_ledger tests pass after fix
  Verify: cd $REPO_ROOT && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_ledger.py -v
- [ ] perf benchmark runs without ValueError

- [ ] No regression on currently-passing tests
